title: Sales Performance Overview: Web Shop (Jan-Sep 2026)
goal: Show the sales director which regions, categories and segments drive net revenue, and how revenue trends month over month.

datasets.summary: 2,000 web-shop order lines from 2026-01-03 to 2026-09-30. One row per order line; revenue is net of discounts (user note).

derived_fields.name: order_size_band
derived_fields.description: Bulk when an order line has 3 or more units.

kpis.name: Net revenue
kpis.description: Sum of revenue (already net of discounts).

thresholds.name: Bulk order line
thresholds.description: Lines at or above this quantity count as bulk.

glossary.definition: Revenue after discounts, as stored in the revenue column.
Customer segment: Consumer, SMB or Enterprise.
